system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

Your team has come to depend on you and your clans strategic minds. You’ve brought it with you and plan on making sure your team has a tactical advantage in every scenario. When you roll initiative or begin a social encounter your allies begin coordinating around you.

All allies gain the Coordinated condition until initiative ends. There are two different variants of Coordinated, one focused on combat called Combat Coordination, the other for Social encounters called Diplomatic Coordination.
